newsitem.title: FRANCE: French/German helicopter project to start in June.
newsitem.headline: French/German helicopter project to start in June.

text.p: French Defence Minister Charles Million said in an interview that the installation of the tools to build the Tiger combat helicopter, a joint venture between France and Germany, would start in June.

"As regards the Tiger programme, we have taken the decision to start the tooling up phase in June 1997," Million said in an interview to be published in Thursday's edition of French daily Le Provencal.
Million said this should allow France to order 25 Tigers between 2000 and 2002, in line with a French five-year defence spending programme.
Eurocopter, which makes the Tiger helicopter, is 70 percent owned by Aerospatiale and 30 percent by Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG.

Millon said the tools needed to build the Tiger would be made at two sites, one of which will be at Marignane near Marseille in the south of France. The first deliveries of the close-support version of the Tiger would start in 2003.
